notes.title: v63 - All codex entries are now unlocked by default : all secrets
notes.notes:
[u][b]All codex entries are now unlocked, [/b][/u]by default for all players.

[b]You can now learn all the VERY secret knowdeldge and historical information [/b]about the war. Make sure to go to the menu, to CODEX and click on all the tabs there to discover the secrets of this conflict.

notes.title: Sorry for the delays, guys
notes.notes:
For weeks I have been wanting to make this announcement. I am a solo-dev, doing what I can to support the game I made. I am just, this summer, in a middle of a  very busy moment for personnal/family reasons, and I hope that I will be ready/able to come back to making some updates on the game very soon, heopfully in the coming months !

Best regards !

Long live Palestine!

notes.title: Update v0.60 - Save Game fix
notes.notes: - fixed SAVE GAME for Single Player game.

notes.title: update v0.59 - easier to see color cost for red cards.
notes.notes:
- the Resume button in the Pause Menu is now easier to see, in order to get back into the game
- the "red" WTO cards have easier to see/read color coded cost on top left of the cards, in order to quickly see if it's an Espionage (Yellow), Political (Blue) or Military(green) card.

notes.title: Update for v 0.58
notes.notes:
- exit button now works to close the game
- cards in the Cards Codex are now locked by default and will unlock as you play

notes.title: v57 UI Battle Screen Update
notes.notes:
- City Battle Screen : a "militay advisor" will now give you hint about what you can do, and remind you if you've placed tokens are not
- Small tooltip pointing to the tokens UI of the city battle screen, so player understand that there NEEDS to be tokens in a city in order to deploy a card
- Codex entries are now unlocked every 10 turns (and also, still, at the end of a game)

notes.title: Update for SYRAK (v55)
notes.notes:
Several fix:

- now possible to match with a friend using a "Room Name" in Online Play
- the chat bubble "shakes" when you receive a message in Online Play
- loading bar in loading scene is now white on red, and easier to see
- codex mechanic is unlocked (you play 1 game = you unlock a codex entry)
